MetaData.Value:
The GeoAccuracy code is made up of the geocoding status and the geocoding level.
Geocoding Status P: Point (A single geocode was found matching the input address) I: Interpolated (A geocode was able to be interpolated from the input addresses location in a range) A: Average (Multiple candidate geocodes were found to match the input address, and an average of these was returned) U: Unable to geocode (A geocode was not able to be generated for the input address)
Geocoding Level 5: Delivery Point (PostBox or SubBuilding) 4: Premise (Premise or Building) 3: Thoroughfare 2: Locality 1: AdministrativeArea 0: None
